name: Card2Crypto — No-KYC Crypto Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
author: cyberhunter1880

sections.description:
Card2Crypto is a no-KYC crypto payment gateway for WooCommerce merchants who want non-custodial cryptocurrency checkout, instant settlement and direct payouts to their own wallet. Customers choose a supported coin from a clean, searchable selector, then complete payment on a polished on-site payment screen with a QR code, exact crypto amount, copy-to-clipboard wallet address and live countdown.

Use Card2Crypto to accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, USDC and other supported cryptocurrency payments on WooCommerce without a merchant account or registration flow. Each order receives a unique payment address, payment status is detected automatically, and paid orders can be updated without a manual refresh.

Features

  • Instant access and instant approval for WooCommerce crypto payments.
  • No merchant registration and no KYC required to start accepting cryptocurrency.
  • Non-custodial settlement flow with payouts forwarded after each paid order directly to your wallet without delays or holds.
  • Unique wallet address assigned to each order for enhanced privacy and payment detection.
  • A-grade on-site checkout experience: searchable crypto coin grid with logos, then a clean payment screen with QR code, amount, copy buttons and a countdown timer.
  • QR code shown on your own site for easy customer payments.
  • Automatic payment detection (orders update without a page refresh).
  • If the customer made a mistake sending to the wrong token or sending through the wrong network our system will still forward the crypto to you automatically for all supported tokens across all chains.
  • 1.5% flat rate fee + blockchain fees.
  • Automatic order processing (order will be marked as paid automatically after payment).
  • Track TXID and payouts from wp-admin.
  • Clean, searchable admin screen to enable coins and set a payout wallet per coin.
  • You can accept payments worldwide without restrictions due to the decentralized nature of how cryptocurrencies work.
  • Please check our website for the minimum transaction amount for each cryptocurrency.
  • Multi-currency cryptocurrency support for WooCommerce stores.
  • Supported networks: BTC – BCH – LTC – doge – ETH – TRC20 – ERC20 – BEP20 – Arbitrum – Polygon – AVAX-C – Optimism – Base – Solana – Monad – Linea.
  • Optional hosted multi-coin mode to enable all cryptocurrencies at one enabled payment method with custom domain name support.

The plugin and the offered service through the Card2Crypto Payment Gateway API is subject to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

External services

This plugin relies on the Card2Crypto cryptocurrency payment API to function. It is a payment gateway, so connecting to this external service is required for it to work.

What it connects to and why:

  • api.card2crypto.org — the payment API. When a customer chooses this gateway, the plugin sends the order total, the store currency, the cryptocurrency the customer selected, the store’s payout wallet address for that coin, and a callback URL on your site. The API returns a unique payment address, the amount due in crypto, the network minimum/fee, and a QR code, and later calls your site’s callback URL to confirm the payment. The plugin also fetches the list of supported coins and their logo images from this endpoint. No customer personal data (name, email, billing address) is sent by the on-site gateway.
  • pay.card2crypto.org (or your own configured custom domain) — used only by the optional “hosted” multi-coin mode, which redirects the buyer to a Card2Crypto-hosted checkout page to complete payment. This is only used if you enable that gateway.

These services are provided by Card2Crypto. By using the gateway you and your customers agree to the Card2Crypto Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
• After installing and activating this plugin go to WooCommerce >>> Settings >>> Payments >>> Card2Crypto.
  • Enable the desired crypto coins and insert your wallet address for each to receive instant payouts. Optionally you can enable the hosted multi-coin mode.
  • Save settings and you will be ready to accept cryptocurrencies directly on your website!

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or greater
  • PHP version 7.2 or greater
sections.faq:
Do I need to sign up as a merchant to use the plugin?

No, the plugin can be used to accept crypto instantly without sign up because we never hold your crypto — it is automatically forwarded to your wallet.

When will I receive payouts?

You will receive payouts instantly to your wallet with every order.

How to fix There Are No Payment Methods Available Error?

Follow the guide at https://card2crypto.org/ to fix the WooCommerce “There Are No Payment Methods Available” error.

I have a problem with one of my orders?

Please contact the Card2Crypto support team to guide you.

I’m receiving payments to my wallet but orders are still pending payment?

The plugin is tested to mark orders as processing automatically after payment. You can follow our troubleshooting guide at https://card2crypto.org/.
sections.changelog:
2.5.3

  • Prevented Card2Crypto checkout controls from widening mobile checkout pages or creating horizontal page scrolling.
  • Added theme-proof border-box sizing and width containment for classic checkout and Checkout Blocks.

2.5.2

  • Enlarged visible coin artwork without widening mobile cards by clipping padded PNG logos inside circular frames.
  • Added a permanent separator and uppercase coin name to the selected blockchain summary.
  • Applied the circular logo and selected-coin formatting consistently to classic checkout and Checkout Blocks.

2.5.1

  • Changed the on-site checkout to a two-step flow: choose the cryptocurrency first, then choose an enabled blockchain network.
  • Added the same coin-first flow to classic checkout and WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks.
  • Improved mobile readability with bold coin tickers, complete coin names underneath and a persistent selected-coin summary during blockchain selection.
  • Added a cache-busting, checkout-scoped coin-card layout so mobile themes cannot reverse the ticker and full-name typography.
  • Preserved the existing coin-network identifiers and payment processing flow.

2.5.0

  • Improved WooCommerce checkout assets and WordPress.org listing copy for the Card2Crypto crypto payment gateway.
  • Confirmed stable release metadata for version 2.5.0.
  • Added WordPress.org plugin assets for icon, banner and screenshots.

2.4.1

  • Unique internal prefixes so the plugin can run alongside other Card2Crypto plugins without function/class conflicts.

V2.0.0

  • Rebranded to Card2Crypto (api.card2crypto.org / pay.card2crypto.org).
  • Brand-new A-grade on-site checkout: searchable coin grid with logos and network badges (classic + block checkout).
  • Redesigned on-site payment screen with QR code, amount, copy-to-clipboard address, a 30-minute visual countdown and an animated payment-status indicator.
  • Cleaner, searchable admin screen for enabling coins and setting per-coin payout wallets, with an active-coin counter and “show enabled only” filter.

V1.1.5

  • Bypassing domain censorship.

V1.1.4

  • Replaced the per-coin gateways with a single dynamic gateway that fetches the coin list from the API. Enable the coins you want and set a payout wallet per coin from one settings screen; enabled coins are offered at checkout (classic and blocks) with the QR code shown on your own site. The Multicoin gateway is unchanged.
  • Fix WooCommerce blocks cart page bug fake dummy items added to cart.
  • Checkout JS bug fix.

V1.1.3

  • Supporting Monad and Linea

V1.1.2

  • Bug fix

V1.1.1

  • Updated coin gateways.
  • Customizing hosted checkout page colors and logo.

V1.1.0

  • Bug fix

V1.0.9

  • Custom domain name option for the hosted multi-coin mode.

V1.0.8

  • Hosted mode option with multi-coin selection in one enabled payment method.

V1.0.7

  • Underpaid tolerance percentage option.

V1.0.0

  • Initial release
